title: Timetable
subtitle: Build the weekly class schedule — generate, adjust, publish.
noBranch: Select a branch to build its timetable.

setup.title: Let's set up your timetable
setup.subtitle: Three quick steps — then the schedule generates itself.
setup.periodsRequired: Save the school day first — the timetable is built on it.

periods.title: Shape your school day
periods.what: The period schedule is the skeleton of one school day: when each class period starts and ends, plus breaks, lunch and the flag ceremony.
periods.why: Lessons attach to period numbers — not clock times — so you can re-time the whole day later and every lesson follows automatically. Start from the standard day and adjust.

rooms.title: Add shared rooms
rooms.what: Only rooms that sections share — laboratories, the ICT room, the gym, the library. Ordinary lessons happen in each section's own classroom, so don't list those.
rooms.why: Subjects that need a special room (Chemistry, HPE, IT…) get a free one booked automatically when the schedule is generated. No shared rooms? Just continue — you can add them any time.

create.title: Create your first timetable
create.what: A timetable starts as a draft — your private working copy. Nobody sees it until you publish.
create.why: Name it, choose whether Saturday is a school day, and create it.
create.next1: Press Generate — every lesson is placed automatically with no clashes.
create.next2: Adjust by hand: move, lock or swap lessons until it feels right.
create.next3: Publish — teachers, students and parents see it instantly.
create.created: Draft created — press Generate to fill it automatically.
create.autoGenerate: Generate the schedule for me now
create.autoGenerateHint: We'll place every lesson automatically — no clashes. You can still adjust it before publishing.
create.noLoadsBody: The generator places each subject as many times as its periods per week. Every subject in this semester is still at 0, so the timetable would come out empty. Open the teaching grid and set the periods first.

periods.title: Period schedule
periods.hint: The daily time blocks. Change a block's end time and the next one starts right there — the rest of the day moves with it. Editing times here re-times every lesson at once — lessons point at period numbers, not clock times.
periods.emptyDesc: Generate the default day from the semester's class window, then adjust.
periods.label: Label
periods.lockedByTimetable: Class periods drive the timetable — removing them removes lessons.
periods.nightWarning: All these times fall in the small hours of the night. If you meant Ethiopian time (2:00 in the morning = 8:00), shift the whole day forward.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.hint: Special rooms (labs, gym…) the timetable books exclusively. Ordinary lessons happen in the section's own room.
rooms.emptyDesc: Add labs, the library, the gym — anything sections share.
rooms.name: Name

versions.title: Versions
versions.name: Name
versions.publishDesc: Teachers, students and parents will see it immediately. The previously published version is archived.
versions.autoGenerate: Generate the schedule for me now
versions.autoGenerateHint: We'll place every lesson automatically — no clashes. You can still adjust it before publishing.
versions.autoGenerateCopyHint: Copied lessons that are not locked will be re-placed. Turn this off to keep the copied grid exactly as it is.
versions.emptyDesc: Create a draft, generate it automatically, adjust, then publish.

grid.placeHint: Pick a lesson, then tap a free cell.
grid.moveHint: Tap a free cell to move it
